description.value: A family-owned motel in Osoyoos situated directly across the street from a public beach on Canada's warmest freshwater lake, in the heart of BC's only desert region. The property offers standard motel rooms, suites, and a separate 3-bedroom vacation cottage, with a seasonal heated saltwater pool and complimentary BBQ facilities on-site. It sits walking distance from downtown Osoyoos restaurants and pubs, close to wineries, the Haynes Point campground, and the US border crossing.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and active; the business is clearly open with a booking button and seasonal pool information. The phone number (250) 495-7641 matches OSM exactly, but the street number differs: OSM shows 6002 89th Street while the website consistently shows 6004 89th Street on both the contact page and vacation cottage page, so the website address is preferred. No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash) are mentioned anywhere on the site; Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed ('Free Wifi and cable TV in rooms') and nearby restaurants/pubs are mentioned as walkable.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists 6002 89th Street but the website consistently shows 6004 89th Street (on both the Contact and Vacation Cottage pages). Website value used.
Name mismatch: OSM name is 'Lakeview Motel and Suites' but the website branding uses 'Osoyoos Lakeview Inn & Suites' / 'Osoyoos Lakeview Inn and Suites'. OSM value retained per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating motel in Osoyoos with an active website and bookings; useful to touring cyclists passing through the southern Okanagan.

Nearby evening food.detail: Website states the motel is 'walking distance to... restaurants, and pubs'
